select count(*) as count from ctrl.audit_log where adf_run_id='@{pipeline().parameters.adf_run_id}'
and status !='SUCCESS'

body.value:
@json(concat(
'{"executionData":{"compute":"Spark"},"parameters":[
{"name":"p_source_path","value":"',
if(
    equals(
        activity('Read Table Details').output.firstRow.source_system,
        'neon_postgres'
    ),
    concat(
        'Files/landing/neon_postgres/',
        activity('Read Table Details').output.firstRow.source_table_name,
        '/',
        variables('start_time')
    ),
    concat(
        'Files/landing/adls_csv/',
        activity('Read Table Details').output.firstRow.source_table_name,
        '/',
        variables('start_time')
    )
),
'","type":"Text"},
{"name":"p_target_table","value":"',
activity('Read Table Details').output.firstRow.silver_table_name,
'","type":"Text"},
{"name":"p_load_type","value":"',
activity('Read Table Details').output.firstRow.load_type,
'","type":"Text"},
{"name":"p_landing_timestamp","value":"',
variables('start_time'),
'","type":"Text"},
{"name":"p_source_file_format","value":"',
activity('Read Table Details').output.firstRow.source_file_format,
'","type":"Text"}
]}'
